name: go-coap-cancellable-failure-aware-listener-30fe
instr:
Make connection admission cancellable, reusable, and failure-aware without sacrificing a listener's bound endpoint. TCP and DTLS servers should recover predictably from transient admission failures while preserving established serving and configuration behavior.

A blocked `AcceptWithContext` on TCP, TLS, or DTLS returns its supplied context error without disrupting other accepts or preventing later connections. Closing any concrete listener takes precedence, releases all accepts, permanently prevents acceptance, and consistently exposes listener closure. `AcceptErrorClass`, `AcceptError`, and its pointer methods `Class` and `Unwrap` in `github.com/plgd-dev/go-coap/v3/net` provide stable permanent, temporary, canceled, and closed classifications while preserving cause identity. `AcceptPolicy` and `WithAcceptPolicy` from `github.com/plgd-dev/go-coap/v3/options` give TCP and DTLS identical bounded retry and pacing semantics, with finite safe zero-value defaults. TCP and DTLS retry temporary admission failures, stop immediately on permanent failures, and return the final failure when the budget is exhausted. DTLS handshake failures are reported, close only the failed connection, permit later connections, and never consume admission retries. Stopping either server interrupts accepts and retry waits, closes tracked connections, and lets serving end normally.
